critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/wholesaler_analytics.py is 959 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. The new Phase 3A distributor-intelligence math (~50-336) is a natural extraction candidate into a `wholesaler_distributor_intel.py` module before Phase 3B adds more.
_compute_distributor_intelligence iterates orders Python-side per distributor — fine for ≤30 distributors, but consider Mongo $group aggregation once a tenant exceeds ~200 distributors / 10k orders.

rev_threshold falls back to mean/2 only when median is 0; if growths are all 0 (current seed) growth_threshold becomes 0 too and every distributor with growth>=0 lands in Stars/Cash Cows. With current seed only MUTKEEM has growth>0 so the matrix is sane, but flag for QA on flat-data tenants.

Frontend WholesalerAnalytics.jsx is 741 lines — DAC sub-components (StatusTile/DistributorRankingTable/ChurnRow/BcgMatrix/MonthlyTrendChart) should move to /views/wholesaler/dac/*.jsx before Phase 3B's Inventory deep dive piles into the same file.
BcgMatrix uses raw px sizing on bubbles; consider a min-size of 8px and a tooltip on hover so users see distributor name + revenue + growth without leaving the matrix.
Status badge color mapping (emerald/amber/rose) is duplicated in two places (StatusTile + DistributorRankingTable). Extract into a shared statusTone() helper to avoid drift.
